applicableAreas: Southern boundary landscape area adjacent to overhead electric line
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows trees planted within 15 feet of overhead electric line (measured 13.2 feet and 3 feet at southern boundary), but plant schedule does not identify tree species at specific landscape plan locations. Cannot verify whether non-utility-compatible species (per ECM Appendix F UC designation) are being installed without species identification on landscape drawing.

applicableAreas: Southern boundary landscape area within 25 feet of overhead electric line
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows multiple trees within 25 feet of overhead electric line, but species are not identified by location on the landscape drawing. Plant schedule includes large trees (Live Oak and Cedar Elm, both with mature heights exceeding 40 feet per ECM Appendix F), but cannot verify if these large-growing species are being planted in the restricted clearance zones.

applicableAreas: Southeastern corner near utility pole on southern boundary
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows tree planted at southeastern boundary approximately 3 feet from utility pole, violating the 10-foot minimum lateral clearance requirement from overhead electric utility poles.

applicableAreas: West side of property near Building 1, transformer pad location
findings.comment: Site plan shows pad-mounted transformer on west side south of Building 1, with a tree well labeled immediately adjacent. Landscape plan does not provide species identification or specific clearance dimensions to verify compliance with 10-foot minimum setback requirement from pad-mounted equipment.

applicableAreas: Interior areas with underground electric utilities
findings.comment: Electrical design plan (Sheet 21) shows underground electric lines, pull boxes, and underground connections throughout the site, but the landscape plan (Sheet 31) does not overlay or cross-reference underground utility locations. Cannot verify that proposed trees are not planted within 5 feet of underground electric equipment.

applicableAreas: Interior landscape areas near underground electric utilities
findings.comment: Electrical plan shows underground electric equipment (pull boxes, underground service lines), but the landscape plan and plant schedule do not provide sufficient detail to identify trees within 20 feet of underground equipment or verify that required root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment) are specified in planting details or notes.

applicableAreas: Southern boundary near overhead electric line; West side near transformer pad
findings.comment: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) displays tree symbols near electric facilities but does not identify species by location. Individual trees are labeled only with functional categories (SY, PL, P, M for mitigation), not scientific or common species names. Plant schedule (Sheet 35) lists proposed species with quantities but is not cross-referenced on the landscape drawing, preventing verification of which species are installed near utilities.

applicableAreas: Southern boundary and west side near electric facilities
findings.comment: Landscape plan does not differentiate large trees (mature height 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) from smaller trees. Plant schedule lists proposed species (including Live Oak and Cedar Elm, both exceeding 40-foot mature height) but does not indicate on the landscape drawing which trees are large-growing species, preventing clear identification of trees requiring the more restrictive 25-foot clearance from distribution conductors.

applicableAreas: Southern boundary near overhead electric line
findings.comment: Landscape plan contains no dimension lines or notes indicating how tree clearances from overhead electric conductors are measured. Without documented measurement methodology on the plans, cannot verify whether clearances are measured from outside conductor (required per UCM 1.10.10.4) or incorrectly from utility pole centerline.

applicableAreas: Southern boundary near overhead electric line
findings.comment: Landscape plan does not indicate whether tree clearance measurements are taken from tree trunk center (planting location, required per UCM 1.10.10.4) or from tree canopy edge. Without explicit dimension lines or notes on the landscape drawing specifying measurement reference point, compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Southern and western property boundaries with overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Although landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows trees and overhead electric line (-OHE-) locations, it does not provide species identification or clearance dimensions necessary to verify compliance with electric utility standards. Reviewers cannot cross-check specific tree species, mature heights, or lateral distances from conductors without supplementary annotations or referenced cross-sections.

applicableAreas: Southern boundary trees within utility clearance zones
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows trees planted within restricted clearance zones from overhead electric infrastructure (within 15 feet of conductors, within 10 feet of poles). No documented written approval letters from Austin Energy authorizing variations to utility clearance standards are visible in the submitted documents. Master Comment Report references Bluebeam platform for Austin Energy detailed review comments, which are not accessible in this documentation set.
